title: Observe Java Future results
why: Ignoring a Future suppresses asynchronous failures and discards the handle needed for cancellation or coordination.
suggestion: Retain, return, compose, or explicitly observe the Future so failures and cancellation remain visible.
limitations: Discarded direct CompletableFuture async factories and known executor submit or schedule calls are reported.
Assignments split across lines, immediately chained result observation, direct call arguments, and submitted FutureTask handles retained independently of the executor's wrapper Future are recognized.

A Future used as the expression body of an immediate stream or parallelStream map on a recognized List, ArrayList, LinkedList, or Vector is passed to the mapping operation. Consumer forEach callbacks and discarded calls in block-bodied map lambdas remain eligible.
Aliases, custom Future-returning methods, other stream sources or intermediate operations, typed lambda parameters, annotations, and deliberate fire-and-forget policies are not inferred.
